positioning.practice: Jimi Ige LLC helps professional-services firms increase the leverage of every knowledge worker through governed AI.
positioning.product: Improved operations are the product. AI is the enabling technology. Governance is why the result is trusted.
outcomes: Increase delivery capacity without sacrificing quality.
Turn institutional knowledge into controlled, reusable leverage.
Adopt AI while protecting client confidentiality, professional judgment, and trust.
positioning.notThis: Not a generic AI automation agency, a chatbot builder, or a tool-specific systems integrator. Never a replacement for professional judgment, and never legal, tax, audit, or accounting advice.
